correctness.rationale: PASS: All-positive trace forces a directed branching. A putative support of n−1 arcs is a spanning arborescence and cannot realize the labeling forbidding every root-outgoing support arc while retaining others. For any branching of size at most n−2 and any positive subset P, the P-forest has t=n−|P| components and at most |S|−|P|<=t−2 blocked root attachments among t−1 nonroot components. Attach all open components directly to the root and each blocked component by an arc from one open component; the branching indegree rule guarantees every new arc avoids negative queries. The rooted-forest count det(nI−J)=k n^{n−k−1} establishes the face polynomial including n=2. Fresh exhaustive direct parent/cycle enumeration matched all supports at n=2..5 (2,16,512,65536 tested).
